stories.title: BEV Diagnostic Fault Code Scenario Randomizer
stories.description: Build CLI tool generating ≥50 unique fault code diagnosis scenarios for BEV KK practice by combining OBD-II codes, symptom clusters, root causes, and repair procedures; enable realistic case-based learning and assessment variety.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/bev_scenario_generator.py generates ≥50 unique fault code scenarios by combining: (1) OBD-II codes extracted from BEV NOSS (P0xxx, P1xxx, P3xxx ranges), (2) symptom clusters (loss of power, battery warning, thermal runaway), (3) root causes linked to CU content, (4) repair step references with CU cross-references

Each scenario includes: fault code, symptom description, expected diagnostics (tools/procedures), repair steps with CU reference (e.g., 'Refer to C02-KP-03 BMS Diagnostics'), and 3-5 assessment questions at Bloom's levels 3-4 (Application/Analysis)

Generated scenarios saved as markdown case studies compatible with KK format (MP-031-3:2016-Scenarios/fault_scenario_001.md); script supports filtering by CU, severity level (critical/major/minor), and tool requirements
